input.quote: 4.1 Term; Termination. This Agreement shall be effective as of that date (the "Effective Date") the Site becomes fully operational as set forth in writing and executed by both Parties and shall continue for a period of one (1) year from the Effective Date. This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
input.rationale: This is a hosting and site-development agreement under which HDI holds the Company's Content, user information and data (Sections 1.4, 1.9, 8.1), yet the termination provisions (Sections 4.1-4.2) address only notice and the Termination Payment. No provision anywhere requires HDI to provide wind-down or migration help, to return or export the Company's Content or data, or to delete it; the survival clause (Section 10.7) and confidentiality provisions do not supply any return or export mechanic. The rule therefore fails at both preferred and fallback levels, and we insert a new Section 4.3 at the preferred level: up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Company Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data return/deletion clause as Section 4.3.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit mechanics, so we added a Section 4.3 requiring HDI, on expiry or termination, to give up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, return our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certify deletion after that return. We can accept the fallback of 90 days' assistance and a 30-day export if six months is an issue.

ops.text: Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination, return to the Company all Content, customer lists and other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company ("Company Data") in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete all Company Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing to the Company.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
